verdict: A very close reproduction whose layout and content line up almost everywhere, but it uses Inter instead of SF Pro and an opaque tab bar instead of the translucent glass one; the structure is a clean, well-named auto-layout tree with components for the repeated rows.

top_defects.where: every text (Today title, feed text, tab labels, status bar clock)
top_defects.what: Inter used instead of SF Pro: wider glyphs and different letter shapes ('Today', 'y', 'a', digits), so the heatmap outlines every word even where sizes and positions match
the reference's Liquid Glass bar shows the blurred 'Liste de Wikimédia' text and the blue rank circle through it; the candidate's bar is near-opaque white with nothing showing through
cellular bars and battery about 15-20% smaller than in the reference (battery ~85x38 px vs ~95x42 px at @3x), the bars sitting lower
Pablo Pagis photo cropped wider (player smaller, more background) than in the reference; the Star Academy thumbnail shows the whole logo where the reference shows a tight crop ('ar / ader' letters)
the reference clips the title at the card edge ('présidentiell'), the candidate truncates it with an ellipsis ('présidentiel...')
front square offset differs from the reference glyph (larger overlap, rounder corners)
no text or color styles/variables (styled: 0); #202122, #72777d, #3366cc and the 15 px sizes are repeated as raw values; the four tab items are not one component

top_defects.where: status bar, tab bar selection, feed
top_defects.what: status bar and the tab selection capsule are absolutely placed; feed and card gaps are fractional magic numbers (62.6, 11.3) tuned to match pixels

strengths: Block geometry matches within a few px from status bar to tab bar: segmented control, Card hidden banner, Games card, Top read rows and their thumbnails
All texts present and exact, French accents included, with the measured Wikipedia colors (#202122, #72777d, #3366cc)
Section header, game question row and top read row are components with instances, inside a named auto-layout tree
